data.gender_notes: Nicoline is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Nikolos, which means 'victory of the people'. In the New Testament, Saint Nicholas was a bishop of Myra in Lycia, known for his generosity and protection of children. The name Nicoline carries the meaning “Victory of the people” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nicoline usually hope their child will grow to embody victory of the people and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Νικολίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Νικολίνη προέρχεται από το ελληνικό όνομα Νικόλαος, που σημαίνει νίκη του λαού. Η Νικολίνη είναι η θηλυκή μορφή του ονόματος Νικόλαος, που έχει τις ρίζες του στην αρχαία Ελλάδα. Το όνομα Νικολίνη έχει μεγάλη σημασία στην χριστιανική παράδοση.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nicoline holds a rich cultural heritage, as it is derived from the venerable figure of Saint Nicholas, a beloved bishop and saint in the Christian faith. Originating from the Greek name Nikolos, meaning 'victory of the people', this name resonates with a sense of triumph and solidarity, inspiring qualities such as kindness, selflessness, and generosity. Historically, Saint Nicholas has been known as the protector of children and sailors, and his legacy has cemented a lasting impact on European and Christian cultures through the popularization of the tradition of leaving gifts for children on his feast day, December 6th.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Nicoline also carries a profound spiritual significance, as it is rooted in the virtuous life and legacy of Saint Nicholas. A true embodiment of love, faith, and generosity, his example serves as an inspiration to people of all ages. By choosing the name Nicoline, one assumes the blessings and protective graces bestowed upon this revered saint. It is believed that Nicholas interceded between God and man, demonstrating an unwavering commitment to help those in need. As a result, the name Nicoline exudes a strong spiritual presence, urging those who bear it to strive for love, kindness, and generosity in their daily lives.
